exposure: Cesarean section in the first birth
cohort: 480 women who had their first delivery in 2004 and a second delivery identified in subsequent follow-ups of the 2004 Pelotas Birth Cohort
finding: Ages 21-34 years, not being seen by SUS in 2004, and having ten or more prenatal visits were associated with an increased risk of repeat cesarean section in women who had a cesarean section in their first birth.
mod_finding: The study found a high prevalence of repeat cesarean section among women who had a cesarean in their first birth, with 87.44% having a second surgical delivery.
